body: Scope `LOG_TAMPERED` symlink/UID checks in `bin/hook-runner.sh` strictly to `$DATA_ROOT`, `$HOOK_LOG_DIR`, and `$HOOK_LOG_FILE` so legitimate dotfile symlinks (e.g. `~/.config` managed by GNU Stow or chezmoi) do not false-trigger headless worker denial when `DATA_ROOT` is under `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, and add a regression test in `test/hook-runner.test.mjs`.
title: Scope hook-runner.sh LOG_TAMPERED check to DATA_ROOT and descendants so symlinked ~/.config dotfiles do not false-deny workers
